name: 70510 · Abbeville, LA
findings: ZIP 70510 (Abbeville) has 52 nonprofit organizations. 25 of them (48%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 20 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (30% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 70510 (Abbeville) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
